title: Legal Document Synthesis for Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct
business: Legal firms managing high-volume contract review and synthesis.
problem: Manual extraction of key clauses from lengthy, multi-page legal documents is error-prone and consumes significant billable hours.
solution: Leverage Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct to process long-context legal documents, utilizing its ability to handle up to 128K tokens and generate structured, accurate summaries of specific contractual obligations.
steps: Load the Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct model using the latest Hugging Face transformers library.
Configure the system prompt to define the role of a specialized legal assistant for structured output.
Apply the chat template to format the long-form contract text as a user message.
Enable YaRN scaling in the model configuration if the input document exceeds 32,768 tokens.
Execute inference to generate a JSON-formatted summary of identified clauses.
outcome: Improved consistency in clause identification and reduced time spent on initial document triage.
limitation: The use of static YaRN scaling for long-context processing can potentially impact performance on shorter texts, requiring developers to toggle the configuration only when necessary.
